solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sign is given by church in additional message

indicators.note: in tells us the first pieces go inside the letters for the additional message

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a message added at the end of a letter
taken as written
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A star sign is revealed by the church in a postscript.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given by' is only a link; a postscript is the message added below a signature.
explanation.definitionFit: Pisces, the Fishes, is one of the twelve zodiac signs of astrology.

clue.text: At home doctor has one exotic animal

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A doctor who makes house calls keeps one unusual pet.
explanation.definitionFit: The indri is a large lemur of Madagascar, an animal foreign to most solvers.

clue.text: Bird William found under bridge

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits beneath the first, so under signals the order

parts.note: to bridge a river is to cross it
Bill is a short form of the name William

explanation.surface: A bird was spotted by William beneath a bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: The crossbill is a finch whose crossed mandibles prise seeds from conifer cones.

clue.text: Star maybe getting a black eye

explanation.surface: A celebrity ends up with a bruised eye.
explanation.definitionFit: Anything that shines, such as a star, is a shiner; shiner is also slang for a bruised eye.

clue.text: Expression of regret about large town's lewdness

indicators.note: about tells us the expression of regret is turned round

parts.note: alas is a cry of sorrow or regret
a city is a large town; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: Someone sighs over a big town's licentious ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Salacity is lustfulness or indecency, a direct synonym for lewdness.

clue.text: Prosperous area in Berks with bottle cork popping

indicators.note: a cork popping flies about, so these letters burst into a new order

parts.note: taken as written; Berks is the short name of Berkshire, an English county

explanation.surface: In a wealthy part of Berkshire, a champagne cork pops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'with' are links. Berks is short for Berkshire, a county west of London; the stockbroker belt is the affluent commuter country around London.
explanation.definitionFit: A stockbroker belt is a well-off commuter district where city financiers live.

clue.text: Behold Italy's new supporter of the government in power

definitions.text: supporter of the government in power

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning behold

indicators.note: new says the letters are made over in a fresh arrangement

parts.note: the letters of the word with its S

explanation.surface: Look at this new Italian backer of the ruling party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' reshuffles Italy's with its S counted as a letter, the possessive here doing real work rather than linking.
explanation.definitionFit: A loyalist is someone who stays faithful to the established ruler or regime.

clue.text: American singer embraces British band

indicators.note: embraces means the singer's name holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: Perry Como was an American crooner

explanation.surface: A US crooner hugs a British pop group.
explanation.definitionFit: A combo is a small band of musicians, especially in jazz.

clue.text: Fruit eaten with grin spreading

indicators.note: spreading suggests the letters fanning out into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Fruit is eaten with a broad smile.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangerine is a small loose-skinned citrus fruit, a kind of mandarin.

clue.text: Reproving a fellow, one politician embracing maiden

indicators.note: embracing says the chain of pieces before it holds the maiden inside

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a college
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
the Roman numeral I is one
a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: Telling off a college man, a Conservative MP hugs a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: M slips in after the D of DON. M for maiden comes from cricket scorecards, where a maiden is an over with no runs scored.
explanation.definitionFit: Admonitory describes words that warn or rebuke, as reproving remarks do.

clue.text: Sort of female to get kiss after short time

indicators.note: after places the kiss behind the short time in the answer

parts.note: min is short for minute, a short time
X is a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: A certain kind of woman expects a quick kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: A minx is an impudent, flirtatious girl, a type of woman.

clue.text: Improperly express what an incompetent mountaineer may do

definitions.text: what an incompetent mountaineer may do

explanation.surface: A clumsy climber also fumbles words.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense reads as two words: an inept climber may fail to reach (miss) the summit (peak).
explanation.definitionFit: To misspeak is to say something wrongly or express oneself badly.

clue.text: One observing King and Queen behind small room

indicators.note: behind puts king and queen after the small room in the answer

parts.note: the loo is the lavatory, a small room
K is the chess abbreviation for king
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Someone peeks at royalty from behind the lavatory.
explanation.definitionFit: A looker is one who looks, an onlooker or observer.

clue.text: Obligation to listen to Asian language

indicators.note: to listen to says we hear the word for obligation spoken

parts.note: a tie is a binding obligation

explanation.surface: Someone feels duty-bound to hear an Asian tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Thai is the official language of Thailand in South-East Asia.

clue.text: What CEO will do to provide backing for the rest

explanation.surface: A chief executive props up the other staff.
explanation.walkthrough: A chief executive will head the board; the bedstead board supports you as you rest in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A headboard is the upright panel at the end of a bed that you lean on when resting.

clue.text: Academician's installed as religious adviser

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician; RA's gives the S
something installed has been put in

explanation.surface: A Royal Academy member has been appointed spiritual counsellor.
explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for a member of the Royal Academy of Arts in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Rasputin was the mystic holy man who advised the last Russian tsar and tsarina.

clue.text: Relation, a leftie, not given the OK

parts.note: an uncle is a relation
a red is a left-winger

explanation.surface: A left-wing relative has been refused approval.
explanation.definitionFit: Something uncleared has not been passed or authorised.

clue.text: Something small — wrap it up in special parcel

indicators.note: to wrap something is to enclose it, so the word it is packed into the parcel
in confirms the word it ends up within the reshuffled parcel
special suggests a parcel prepared differently, a cue to rearrange its letters
in a down clue up means the word it is read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A small item should be wrapped up in a special package.
explanation.walkthrough: 'special' reshuffles the parcel, and in a down clue 'up' flips the little word before it goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A particle is a tiny piece or speck of something.

clue.text: Melancholic season here again? Retreat

parts.note: fall is the American word for autumn, the wistful season
to be back is to be here again

explanation.surface: Sad autumn returns, prompting a withdrawal.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall back is to retreat; a fallback is a retreat or reserve position.

clue.text: Men aboard taking front off propeller

indicators.note: taking front off says the first letter of the propeller word is dropped

parts.note: a ship's screw is its propeller

explanation.surface: Sailors remove the front of a ship's propeller.
explanation.definitionFit: The crew is the body of people who work on a ship.

clue.text: Fatty solid could be black, say

definitions.text: Fatty solid could be black, say

parts.words: Fatty solid could be black, say
parts.note: a fatty spread from cream which, browned in a pan, becomes the beurre noir of French cooking

explanation.definitionFit: Butter is a solid dairy fat, and black butter (beurre noir) is one cooked form of it.

clue.text: A learner among finest, most clever

indicators.note: among says the learner sits inside the word for finest

parts.note: best means finest
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A student is counted with the top performers, the brightest.
explanation.definitionFit: Ablest is the superlative of able, meaning most capable or clever.

clue.text: Bird dog heading off

indicators.note: heading off says the first letter of the dog is removed

parts.note: a beagle is a hunting dog

explanation.surface: A bird dog runs away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bird dog' looks like one phrase, a gun dog, but splits into definition and fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The eagle is a large bird of prey.

clue.text: Way to get around obstruction in chancy game

indicators.note: to get around says the way goes round the next piece

parts.note: a route is a way
a let is an old word for hindrance, as in 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: Finding a path past a blockage is a gamble.
explanation.definitionFit: Roulette is a casino game of pure chance on a spinning wheel.

clue.text: Old character that may get under your skin

definitions.text: that may get under your skin

explanation.surface: An old rogue knows how to irritate you.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is the Old English letter (a rune) for 'th'; the second is a prickle that pierces skin.
explanation.definitionFit: The rune þ was an Old English letter, and a prickle on a rose can lodge in your skin.

clue.text: Group expressing anger to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some members of a crowd are showing their fury.
explanation.definitionFit: A gang is a group of people acting together.

clue.text: See fashion writer

parts.note: a see is a bishop's seat; Chester is a cathedral city and see in north-west England
ton is an old word for fashion or style

explanation.surface: Look at this fashion columnist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' wants to be an instruction, but it is the diocese.
explanation.definitionFit: G. K. Chesterton was an English author, creator of Father Brown.

clue.text: Disciple of our era present with holy books

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, labels our era
to be present is to be here
NT is the New Testament, a set of holy books

explanation.surface: A follower of the faith in modern times has scripture to hand.
explanation.definitionFit: An adherent is a follower of a leader or cause, as a disciple is.

clue.text: I had to be in clique, up with the pony set?

indicators.note: to be in says the shortened I had goes inside the clique

parts.note: a ring is a clique or gang
I'd is short for I had

explanation.surface: Joining the in-crowd means mixing with horsey types.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone riding is up on a horse, as members of the pony set would be.
